timothy1.5.p1.b1.text: Do not rebuke an older man, but appeal to him as to a father. Treat younger men as brothers,

timothy1.5.p1.b2.text: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with absolute purity.

timothy1.5.p1.b3.text: Honor the widows who are truly widows.

timothy1.5.p1.b4.text: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, …

timothy1.5.p2.b5.text: The widow who is truly in need and left all alone puts her hope in God and continues night and day in her petitions and prayers.

timothy1.5.p2.b6.text: Give these instructions to the believers, so that they will be above reproach.

timothy1.5.p2.b7.text: If anyone does not provide for his own, … he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

timothy1.5.p3.b8.text: A widow should be enrolled if she is at least sixty years old, the wife of one man,

timothy1.5.p3.b9.text: and well known for good deeds such as bringing up children, entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, imparting relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.

timothy1.5.p3.b10.text: But refuse to enroll younger widows. …

timothy1.5.p4.b11.text: At the same time they will also learn to be idle, going from house to house …

timothy1.5.p4.b12.text: So I advise the younger widows to marry, have children, and manage their households, …

timothy1.5.p4.b13.text: If any believing woman has dependent widows, she must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened, …

timothy1.5.p5.b14.text: Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor, especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching.

timothy1.5.p5.b15.text: For the Scripture says, “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain,” and, “The worker is worthy of his wages.”

timothy1.5.p5.b16.text: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder, except on the testimony of two or three witnesses.

timothy1.5.p6.b17.text: I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels to maintain these principles without bias, and to do nothing out of partiality.

timothy1.5.p6.b18.text: Do not be too quick in the laying on of hands …

timothy1.5.p6.b19.text: Stop drinking only water and use a little wine instead, …

timothy1.5.p6.b20.text: In the same way, good deeds are obvious, and even the ones that are inconspicuous cannot remain hidden.
